verdict.rationale: Subscribing to events via webhooks is a fair question for an agent SDK, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents in-process hook callbacks (e.g. on tool calls or session start) and streaming output, not registrable outbound HTTP webhooks that an external consumer can receive. These are adjacent developer building blocks, not the webhook capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
